**Not covered by this configuration:**

- 2023 and later model years (E210 facelift, Toyota Safety Sense 3.0; not supported by openpilot)
- 2.0 L petrol trims (SE, XSE) and the manual transmission
- Corolla Hybrid
- Corolla Hatchback
- Corolla Cross, Lexus UX and other platform siblings
- GR Corolla
- Markets other than the US
